evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 was about 4-5 ppm after purge and through the ramp.
Exhaust O2 rose steadily during growth: 8.9, 12.7, 18.7, 24.3, then 26.0 ppm.
Argon flow held steady at about 100 sccm, so less purge gas does not explain the O2 rise.
Thermocouple held steady at 750 °C and heater power at about 45%.
Pressure gauge is not installed, so the tube atmosphere and pressure cannot be checked.

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure reading or a leak check would show whether this is a seal leak (air coming in) or a blocked exhaust (pressure building up). Characterizing the sample after the run is also needed.
